title: Closed synthetic generator configuration and derivation manifests

sampled_integer.$comment: Signed values are required for decimal-tick ranges with negative endpoints.

FieldDrawLedgerEntry.$comment: The 71 branches are extensionally equal to evaluator/development_scenarios.yaml generator_field_registry.fields in ordered_field_ids order. Each branch binds field identity, declared value type, allowed form, ledger draw_rule (the registry heldout_draw value), and the canonical non-null value shape. A null resolved_value is permitted only for scenario-specific fields that are semantically inapplicable; it is never permitted for the common resolved fields.

rng_draw_count.$comment: Dependency resolution is deterministic and consumes no RNG draw, including event_arrays.group_effect.

group_effect.$comment: Complete event-ID-ordered gamma vector in gamma_i*h_j, where h_j is exactly 0 for reference and 1 for at_risk. Resolved without an RNG draw during dependency stage event_arrays and applied before participant-effect and measurement-noise terms.

source_contract_sha256.$comment: Recomputed by the evaluator from the exact selected scenario registry sources; a submitted digest is not authority.

source_parameter_manifest_sha256.$comment: Non-null only for TRANSFORMED_SOURCE and authenticated independently by the evaluator.

root_assignment_context.$comment: The evaluator supplies and resolves the expected context; the manifest may only repeat it.

TruthType.$comment: Every type except no_recoverable_order_or_stage and refitted_null_transformation requires THRESHOLD_STAGE truth with one aligned numeric stage per participant. Those two no-recoverable-signal types require stage truth NONE with an empty participant-stage vector.
